original_test_intent: Validate each Type 20 Interleave Position within its complete memory interleave set, distinguishing non-interleaved zero and unknown FFh from valid numbered participants, and verify stability after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 records, bind raw position bytes to device/range handles, decode 0/FFh/version semantics, group records into approved interleave sets, validate unique positions against factor/participants, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines expected interleave sets and approves reboot; no memory interleave reconfiguration is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version/field length and raw 0/FFh semantics
Expected interleave sets, factors and participating Type 17 devices
Resolved Type 19/20 range topology and OS-map context
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map collection; never change DIMMs, channels, interleave policy, firmware or kernel.
Preserve raw position byte and distinguish zero/unknown from a numbered slot.
Validate the entire participant set; never accept an isolated positive position without factor/membership evidence.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on invalid/duplicate set or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode positions, resolve device/range identity, group complete sets, validate positions/factor/participants and compare pre/post reboot.
Report unknown, duplicate, missing, out-of-factor or drifting positions without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve interleave set/factor, participant and 0/FFh policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret vendor/logical interleave layouts and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot preserve raw sentinel values, identify the interleave set or validate all positions/factor.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 data; report each device/range, raw/decoded position, set membership, factor, duplicate/missing results and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Interleave Position scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no configuration change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Version-decode raw positions, resolve devices/ranges, form each approved set, distinguish non-interleaved/unknown, require unique positions within factor and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems exposing Type 20 interleave positions.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 20 Interleave Position and related handle definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw sentinel handling, set grouping, factor and participant completeness.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects unknown-as-position, duplicate/missing slots and wrong set membership missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved sets, factor, numbering and sentinel policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS topology metadata does not itself prove runtime interleave performance; that requires a separate approved method.

project_override_considerations: A project may define non-interleaved, multiple or vendor-specific sets, but must document participants/factor and raw-value semantics; it cannot accept isolated positions without set validation.
expected_evidence: Approved interleave set/factor, participants, numbering and sentinel policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-device/range raw/decoded position and complete set map
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot set diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Interleave Position is a valid Type 20 field; expected sets and factor are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding, grouping and set-consistency validation are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw sentinel, participant-set and factor consistency validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains interleave safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates expected topology/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a position label from passing when it is Unknown, duplicated, outside the factor or detached from its interleave peers.
independent_technical_reasoning: Interleave position is relational but all relationships are machine-readable; the owner supplies expected grouping without introducing manual core work.
